persona: HPC cluster administrator moving into GPU performance work
resumeText:
Ananya Iyer | Pune | ananya.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE

- Added 16 NVIDIA A100 GPU nodes and installed GPU drivers and the CUDA toolkit.
- Wrote Python tools that summarise job usage per department.

Linux Administrator, Western Ghats Infotech, Pune (2020 - 2022)
- Patched and hardened 200 RHEL servers for internal applications.

SKILLS
Linux, Slurm, MPI, CUDA, C++, Python, Ansible

BE Computer Engineering, College of Engineering Pune, 2020
